The 45 Hz chain with NOTHING pinned: no allowed_machines, no machine_width, every network free to take any aligned block of either cluster at any width the profile carries. The solver is told what the hardware admits -- the matrix engine is legal on cluster 0 -- and what each width costs, and derives the placement itself. Identical to wh_chain45_free's 30 Hz sibling except for the camera period and the instance count the 500 ms horizon holds; the window budgets and the chain deadline are absolute and unchanged, as they are between the 30 Hz and 120 Hz specs.

DETERMINISM PROBE: byte-equal to wh_chain45_free.json apart from this note and the scheduler random_seed. Solved with XPURT_CPSAT_WORKERS=1, which is the only setting under which CP-SAT is reproducible (xpu-rt/cpsat_scheduler.py). The pair asks two different questions: det1 keeps seed 42 and asks whether one worker lands on the placement the 8-worker solve found; det2 changes the seed and asks whether that placement is a property of the problem rather than of one draw.

chain.deadline_rationale: a frame's goal reaches control within its nav window (77.8 ms); control is phase-locked at 100 Hz and acts on the newest goal
